section_entries.mathematical_role: Uses Littlewood-Jensen reductions, differential-polynomial proxies, a mollifier optimization, and a completed-zeta auxiliary function to obtain derivative-zero abundance and distinct-zero bounds.

neighboring_unit_entries.title: Multiplicity and symmetry turn Littlewood's lemma into a distinct-zero deficit bound
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: Uses the auxiliary function's behavior at simple and multiple zeros plus symmetry about the critical line to lower-bound its weighted zero sum by the gap between total and distinct zero counts, then applies Jensen.

neighboring_unit_entries.title: Normalized parameter choice certifying the distinct-zero proportion
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: Imposes the normalization needed by Littlewood's lemma, specializes the affine polynomial and mollifier parameters, and reports the evaluated constant that yields the final distinct-zero lower bound.

related_synthesis_entries.claim: An auxiliary combination of the completed zeta function and its derivative detects multiplicity loss; symmetry and Littlewood-Jensen turn that loss into a distinct-zero deficit; rewriting the detector as a differential polynomial enables a mollified mean-square bound and a numerical certificate.
